reports.title: Research Update - Authoritative REU Validation
reports.content:
**NSF REU Opportunities – AI/ML (Undergraduate – July 25, 2025) – Actionable Shortlist** **1. University of Maryland – CAAR Program** * **Focus:** Combinatorics, Algorithms, and AI for Real Problems * **Deadline:** Application deadline is February 16, 2024 https://www.cs.umd.edu/projects/reucaar/ * **Eligibility:** Undergraduates (U.S. citizens or permanent residents) with a strong interest in mathematics, computer science, or a related field. Specifically, they seek students with a minimum GPA of 3.0. https://www.cs.umd.edu/projects/reucaar/ * **Details:** Students will work on projects in areas like graph algorithms, data mining, and AI applications. Mentorship is provided by faculty within the Center for Applied Architectural Research (CAAR). * **Contact:** Dr. Michael Carey, Program Director, CAAR, University of Maryland. https://www.cs.umd.edu/projects/reucaar/ * **Application Link:** https://www.cs.umd.edu/projects/reucaar/ **2. University of North Texas – REU Program** * **Focus:** Machine Learning and Data Science * **Deadline:** Application deadline is January 26, 2024 https://ci.unt.edu/reu/index * **Eligibility:** Open to all undergraduate students. No specific major requirements are listed, but a strong background in mathematics and/or computer science is recommended. https://ci.unt.edu/reu/index * **Details:** The program involves research in areas such as deep learning, computer vision, and natural language processing. Students will work with faculty on cutting-edge projects. * **Contact:** Dr. Christopher R. Jones, REU Program Coordinator, University of North Texas. https://ci.unt.edu/reu/index * **Application Link:** https://ci.unt.edu/reu/index **Notes & Uncertainty:** * All deadlines listed are based on information available on the program websites as of November 2, 2023. It is *crucial* to verify these dates on the official NSF website ([URL_1]) and the individual program websites before submitting an application. * Eligibility criteria are subject to change. Confirm all requirements with the specific program contact. * The NSF website ([URL_1]) provides a comprehensive list of REU programs. It is recommended to regularly check this resource for updates and new opportunities.
